description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and accuracy@1. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. A blue solid line with circular markers represents GPT-4o; it begins at (1, 24.4), increases to (3, 28.9), reaches a peak at (5, 31.1), and then decreases to (7, 20.0). A light blue dashed line with cross markers represents Claude-3.5-Sonnet; it begins at (1, 26.7), increases to (3, 27.8), decreases to (5, 24.4), and then decreases further to (7, 20.0).
